tool_analysis:
## Step Analysis
The recorded steps demonstrate a comprehensive GitLab projects search tool with the following accomplishments:
1. Navigated to GitLab and authenticated (user registration/login)
2. Reached the Explore projects page where search/filter controls are available
3. Demonstrated search functionality with different terms ("automation", "test")
4. Demonstrated project type filtering (Trending, Most stars, All)
5. Demonstrated sorting options (Most stars, Last updated, Name)
6. Demonstrated visibility filtering (Public, Any, Private, Internal)
7. Demonstrated archive filtering (Show archived projects, Hide archived projects)
8. Discovered ownership filtering (Owned by anyone, Owned by me)

## Task Definition
Create a tool that searches GitLab projects with:
- Search term input (text search)
- Project type selection (Trending, Most stars, All)
- Sorting options (Last updated, Name, Oldest updated, Oldest created, Last created, Most stars)
- Archive status filtering (Hide archived, Show archived, Show archived only)
- Visibility filtering (Any, Private, Internal, Public)
- Ownership filtering (Owned by anyone, Owned by me)

## Action Plan
1. Navigate to the Explore projects page (starting point)
2. Input search term into search field
3. Select project type (Trending/Most stars/All)
4. Apply sorting option
5. Apply archive filter
6. Apply visibility filter
7. Apply ownership filter
8. Extract search results

## Variable Identification
Based on the recorded steps and URL parameters observed:
1. `search_term` - Text to search for in project names/descriptions
2. `project_type` - Type of projects to show (trending, starred, all)
3. `sort_by` - Sort order for results
4. `archived` - Archive status filter
5. `visibility_level` - Project visibility level
6. `personal` - Ownership filter

## Step Optimization
The tool can be optimized using URL manipulation since all filters are GET parameters:
- Base URL: http://172.26.116.102:8080/explore/projects/{project_type}
- Parameters: name={search_term}, sort={sort_by}, archived={archived}, visibility_level={visibility_level}, personal={personal}

This allows replacing multiple UI interactions with a single navigation step using URL parameters, making the tool more efficient and reliable.
name: tool_search_projects
description: Search GitLab projects with user-provided search terms and optional filters for project type, sorting, archived status, visibility, and ownership

steps.description: Navigate to the Explore projects page with the specified project type
Apply all search and filter parameters via URL manipulation
Capture the search results for analysis
steps.goal: Extract all project search results including project names, descriptions, star counts, and other metadata

input_schema.name: search_term
input_schema.description: Search query text to filter projects by name or description

input_schema.name: project_type
input_schema.description: Project type: 'trending' for trending projects, 'starred' for most stars, empty for all projects

input_schema.name: sort_by
input_schema.description: Sort order: 'latest_activity_desc' (Last updated), 'name_asc' (Name), 'latest_activity_asc' (Oldest updated), 'created_asc' (Oldest created), 'created_desc' (Last created), 'stars_desc' (Most stars)

input_schema.name: archived
input_schema.description: Archive filter: 'true' to show archived projects, 'only' to show only archived projects, empty to hide archived projects

input_schema.name: visibility_level
input_schema.description: Visibility level: '0' for Private, '10' for Internal, '20' for Public, empty for Any

input_schema.name: personal
input_schema.description: Ownership filter: 'true' for Owned by me, empty for Owned by anyone
